claim: This is the highest number of people displaced in a single demolition in occupied East Jerusalem since UN records began in 2009.
label: UNVERIFIED
annotatorNote: Rule 1: the record rests only on the UN's own data - OCHA's records since 2009, given in the UN Spokesperson's briefing of 6 Oct 2026 and repeated by Xinhua on 7 Oct (after the article: Rule 3). No independent count of East Jerusalem demolitions was found to confirm it.
